AN OLD IDEA. A NEW LIFE.

Welcome to the light table.

See the whole roll.

Photographers once printed an entire roll on a single sheet to see the story between frames. Afterlight brings that workflow to digital video. Each clip is sampled at 12 evenly spaced times.

Make a paper edit.

Open a clip, click any frame to seek, mark in and out, and leave a note. Order your selections in Paper edit. Source times are measured in seconds, with millisecond display precision.

Your files stay local.

The browser decodes your video. We save contact images, notes and ranges in this browser. Reloading releases your original files. Add the same files again to relink them and continue editing.

Keep a copy.

Export a project backup before clearing browser storage. Use one editing tab at a time. Up to 60 clips, 500 selections and 2 GB per file are supported. Codec support depends on your browser. H.264 MP4 and VP9 WebM are recommended.

About the sample.

The Last Screening is a three-clip demonstration made from an original AI-generated photograph with camera motion. The app processes those MP4 files through the same import pipeline as your footage.
